# MULAN 沐岚

> MULAN (沐岚) is a Foshan factory making aging-friendly bathroom products, from seated showers to rise-assist stands and grab bars, for distributors, OEM brands and care operators.

> 沐岚（MULAN）是佛山的适老化卫浴工厂，为经销商、OEM 品牌和养老机构提供坐式淋浴器、电动起身助力架和安全扶手等产品。

Foshan Mulan Zhijia Building Materials Co., Ltd. (佛山市沐岚智家建材有限公司), 2F06a, Tao Li Fang, Ceramic Headquarters Base, Chancheng District, Foshan, Guangdong, China. Ships to the Middle East and West Asia; Japan is the new focus. B2B and OEM enquiries: WhatsApp +86 136 6003 9128.

## Products
- [Aging-friendly smart bathroom package](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/smart-bathroom-package/): MULAN's aging-friendly smart bathroom package plans a whole bathroom around older users: a human presence sensor, warm lighting, a smart bath heater, anti-slip handrails, an SOS call button, a seated shower, a smart toilet with lift assist and a cabinet a wheelchair can roll under..
- [Multifunctional seating shower](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/seating-shower/): MULAN's multifunctional seating shower is a freestanding unit with a seat, so older users or people with limited mobility can shower sitting or standing.
- [Multifunctional split shower](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/split-shower/): MULAN's multifunctional split shower mounts on the wall with upper and lower spray arms that rotate, plus shoulder spray, a hand shower and an optional top spray.
- [Electric rise-assist stand](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/rise-assist-stand/): MULAN's electric rise-assist stand fits over the toilet and raises the seat at one touch, silently and to any height, stopping wherever the user releases the button.
- [Wall-mounted shower chair](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/shower-chair/): MULAN's wall-mounted shower chair gives older users a soft PU seat pad, anti-slip TPR feet and independently folding armrests.
- [Wall-mounted folding stool](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/folding-stool/): MULAN's wall-mounted folding stool flips 180° up and down, carries up to 250 kg and has raised anti-slip particles on the seat.
- [Grab bars and armrests](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/grab-bars/): MULAN makes L-shaped grab bars, U-shaped and side flip-up toilet armrests and washbasin armrests.
- [Smart bathroom cabinet](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/products/smart-bathroom-cabinet/): MULAN's smart bathroom cabinet lets a wheelchair roll under the basin, and its mirror tilts by hand from 0 to 15 degrees so users of different heights, seated or standing, can see themselves.

## Blog
- [How to make a bathroom safe for elderly parents: a checklist](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/bathroom-safety-checklist-for-elderly-parents/): A practical checklist to make a bathroom safe for elderly parents: grab bars, shower seating, toilet support, night lighting and the order to do it in.
- [Seated shower vs shower chair: which suits older users?](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/seated-shower-vs-shower-chair/): Seated shower or shower chair for an elderly person? Compare installation, warmth, carer effort, space and fit, with a checklist for choosing.
- [Toilet lift assist for elderly users: what to check first](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/toilet-rise-assist-stand-buying-guide/): Who needs a toilet lift assist, how it compares with rails and raised seats, and nine things to check before buying for a home or care home.
- [Where to install grab bars in a bathroom: shapes and positions](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/where-to-install-grab-bars/): Where to install grab bars in a bathroom: toilet, shower, basin and door positions, ADA heights, which shape goes where, and how to see them at night.
- [Winter bathroom safety for older people and heat shock](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/winter-bathroom-safety-older-people/): How to cut winter heat shock risk for older people: warm the bathroom, keep baths short and below 41°C, and add seating and grab bars.
- [Care home bathroom design requirements: an 8-part spec](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/care-home-bathroom-specification/): An 8-part specification for age-friendly care-home bathrooms: space, floors, showering, toilets, grab bars, vanity, warmth and call systems.
- [One supplier or several for care-home bathrooms?](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/one-supplier-vs-many-care-home-bathrooms/): Single supplier or several for an aging-friendly bathroom project? Compare consistency, risk, cost control and after-sales, with a buyer checklist.
- [Wheelchair-accessible bathroom vanity: what to specify](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/wheelchair-accessible-bathroom-cabinet/): What to specify for a wheelchair-accessible bathroom vanity in care projects: knee clearance, basin height, mirror position, taps and storage.
- [Sourcing bathroom safety products from China: 10 questions](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/sourcing-aging-friendly-bathroom-products-from-china/): How to source bathroom safety products from China: 10 questions to ask a supplier, a comparison table for answers, and checks before you pay a deposit.
- [OEM bathroom safety products: how private label works](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/oem-aging-friendly-bathroom-products/): How OEM and private label work with a bathroom safety products manufacturer: routes compared, step-by-step process and who owns what.
- [Japan elderly care market: a guide for bathroom importers](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/japan-elderly-care-market-bathroom-products/): Japan's elderly care market for bathroom products: official ageing and bathing-accident data, buyer channels, long-term care rules and supplier checks.
- [Chinese New Year 2027: factory shutdown and order deadlines](https://touchigh.github.io/mulan/blog/chinese-new-year-2027-order-lead-times/): Chinese New Year 2027 falls on 6 February. How the factory shutdown works and a backward-planning timeline for bathroom product orders.
